name: Laya Decision
description: Send an assessment text to a Laya decision model and get a routable decision with Laya's probabilities, confidence and every other answer.

properties.label: Decision URL
properties.description: Full URL of the Laya decision endpoint. Keep it in a secret: {{secrets.LAYA_DECISION_URL}}.

properties.label: HTTP headers
properties.description: Optional headers as a FEEL context, for example ={"Authorization": "Bearer {{secrets.LAYA_API_KEY}}"}.

properties.label: Assessment text
properties.description: Text Laya decides on, for example an AI agent's final answer: agent.responseText.

properties.label: Decision question
properties.description: Name of the Laya answer that holds the decision choice.

properties.label: Approve choice
properties.description: Laya choice that leads to the approved outcome.

properties.label: Reject choice
properties.description: Laya choice that leads to the rejected outcome.

properties.label: Any other choice (such as review)
properties.description: How to decide when Laya returns a choice that is neither the approve nor the reject choice.

choices.name: Higher of the approve and reject probabilities (tie: rejected)
The other-choice outcome, for a separate path

properties.label: Approved outcome value
properties.description: Value written to finalDecision for the approved outcome; match your gateway conditions.

properties.label: Rejected outcome value
properties.description: Value written to finalDecision for the rejected outcome.

properties.label: Other-choice outcome value
properties.description: Value written to finalDecision when the policy keeps another choice.

properties.label: Request field
properties.description: JSON field of the request body that carries the assessment text.

properties.label: Status field
properties.description: Response field that reports the call status.

properties.label: Error status value
properties.description: Status value that means the API failed even though it answered HTTP 200.

properties.label: Error message field
properties.description: Response field that holds the error message.

properties.label: Model field
properties.description: Response field that names the answering model.

properties.label: Read timeout (seconds)
properties.description: Laya can take more than two minutes for long assessments.

properties.label: Operation
properties.description: The operation to execute

properties.label: Version
properties.description: Version of the element template

properties.label: ID
properties.description: ID of the element template

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Name of variable to store the response in

properties.label: Result expression
properties.description: Expression to map the response into process variables

properties.label: Error expression
properties.description: Expression to handle errors. Details in the documentation.

properties.label: Retries
properties.description: Number of retries

properties.label: Retry backoff
properties.description: ISO-8601 duration to wait between retries
